info.name: ShipX Logistics API — Dev (Live)
info.description:
Live **dev** environment collection for ShipX Logistics Platform.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Import **ShipX_Dev_Live.postman_environment.json** and select it as the active environment.
3. The pre-request script will automatically fetch and cache a Cognito JWT before each request.

## Auth
Authentication is via **Cognito JWT** (Bearer token). The pre-request script calls `AWSCognitoIdentityProviderService.InitiateAuth` using the credentials in the environment and caches the `id_token` for 55 minutes. You do not need to set the Authorization header manually.

## Default user
- **Email:** `platform@shipx.com`
- **Role:** `platform_admin`
- **Tenant:** `PLATFORM`

## Base URL
`https://2vjfv7dvu8.execute-api.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com`

## Typical Workflow
1. Use Platform Admin endpoints to create a tenant
2. Use Tenant Admin endpoints to create staff users and customers
3. Create Containers → Packing Lists → Manifests → Billing → Release

exec: // Fetches a Cognito JWT and caches it for 55 minutes.
// Runs before every request; skips if the cached token is still valid.
// pm.variables.get() resolves: active environment → collection variables.
// Fill credentials in the collection Variables tab, or import ShipX_Dev_Live.postman_environment.json.
if (!clientId) { console.warn('cognito_client_id not set — fill it in the collection Variables tab'); return; }
// pm.sendRequest requires headers as [{key, value}] array — plain objects
// are silently dropped by the Postman SDK, causing UnknownOperationException.
if (err) { console.error('Cognito auth failed:', err); return; }
// Cache for 55 min (tokens expire after 60 min)

item.name: 0. Auth (Cognito)
item.description:
All auth operations call Cognito directly via the pre-request script.

**How to use:**
1. Fill `cognito_username`, `cognito_password` in the collection **Variables** tab
2. Click **Send** on any request — the pre-request script calls Cognito
3. Check the **Test Results** tab for pass/fail and **Console** (View → Console) for details

**Why pre-request scripts?** Postman's native request engine adds headers that confuse the Cognito endpoint. `pm.sendRequest` sends headers exactly as specified.

**Switch users:** change `cognito_username` + `cognito_password` in Variables, run Login again.

item.name: Login
item.description:
Logs in with cognito_username + cognito_password. Tokens stored automatically.
If first login, response will show NEW_PASSWORD_REQUIRED — run New Password Challenge next.

exec: console.warn('NEW_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: run the New Password Challenge request.');
if (!raw) { pm.test('No Cognito response stored', () => pm.expect(false).to.be.true); return; }
pm.test('Success — tokens stored in collection variables', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true);
pm.test('Challenge: ' + body.ChallengeName + ' — see console for next step', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true);

request.description: The actual Cognito call runs in the pre-request script via pm.sendRequest (which reliably sends headers). Check the Postman Console (View → Console) and the Test Results tab for the outcome.

item.description:

item.name: 1. Platform Admin
item.description:
Super-admin routes for managing tenants and platform settings.
Set X-Role to `platform_admin` for these endpoints.

query.description: Filter by action e.g. TENANT_UPDATED, TENANT_CREATED (optional)

request.description: GET /v1/platform/tenants/{id}/usage — per-tenant API usage breakdown (platform_admin)

item.name: 2. Tenant Admin
item.description:
Tenant configuration, users, charge types, and dollar rate.
Set X-Role to `tenant_admin` for these endpoints.

request.description:
Update a tenant user's full_name and/or role.

Supported fields:
- `full_name` (string): display name — synced to Cognito `name` attribute
- `role` (string): new role — synced to Cognito `custom:role` attribute

Email cannot be changed (Cognito login username is immutable).
PUT /v1/tenant/charge-types/{id} — update a charge type (tenant_admin)
DELETE /v1/tenant/charge-types/{id} — deactivate a charge type; returns 204 (tenant_admin)
DELETE /v1/tenant/users/{id} — deactivate a tenant user; returns 204 (tenant_admin)

item.name: 3. Customers
item.description: Customer management. Staff can create/update; customers can only read.

request.description:
Anonymise a customer record (GDPR Art. 17 — Right to Erasure).

Nulls all PII fields (name, email, phone, whatsapp, address, contract_details) and sets `anonymised_at`. The UUID shell is kept for FK integrity.

Requires: `tenant_admin` role.

Export all personal data held for a customer (GDPR Art. 20 — Right to Portability).

Returns a machine-readable JSON object containing:
- `customer`: profile data
- `billing_summary`: invoice history
- `shipments`: shipment tracking records
- `claims`: damage/missing/seized item claims
- `exported_at`: ISO timestamp

Requires: `tenant_admin` role.
Public endpoint — no auth required. Customer looks up shipment by tracking code + phone number.

item.name: 5. Packing Lists
item.description: Packing list lifecycle: draft → submitted → approved/rejected → manifest auto-created on approval.

request.description: PATCH /v1/packing-lists/{id}/reject — reject a submitted packing list (tenant_admin); status → rejected

item.name: 6. Manifests
item.description: Manifests are auto-created when a packing list is approved. Use verify to confirm cargo against physical arrival.

item.name: 7. Billing
item.description: Billing records, charges, storage fees, disputes, and carryovers.

request.description: PATCH /v1/billing/carryovers/{id}/exempt — mark a carryover as exempted (tenant_admin)
POST /v1/billing/disputes — staff-created CBM dispute (billing_id in body; tenant_admin or nigeria_office_staff)
PATCH /v1/billing/disputes/{id}/reject — reject a CBM dispute with a reason (tenant_admin or nigeria_office_staff)

item.name: 8. Claims
item.description: Damage claims, missing items, and seized items. Use presigned URL to upload evidence photos.

body.raw:
{
  "resolution_type": "refund",
  "amount_usd": 80.00,
  "amount_ngn": 132000.00,
  "reason": "Water damage confirmed during inspection. Partial refund for value of damaged goods.",
  "notes": "Customer accepted refund offer"
}

request.description: POST /v1/uploads/presigned-url — generate an S3 presigned PUT URL for uploading claim evidence photos

item.name: 9. Payment & Release
item.description: Confirm customer payments, generate release notes for pickup, and record actual pickups.

body.raw:
{
  "cartons_released": 2,
  "is_delegate": true,
  "delegate_name": "Chukwuemeka Nwosu",
  "delegate_phone": "+2348056789012",
  "delegate_id_type": "national_id",
  "delegate_id_number": "NIN-987654321",
  "notes": "Delegate presented valid authorization letter"
}

item.name: 10. Refunds
item.description:
Refund request workflow: create → accounts review → approve/reject.
Types: overpayment | cbm_correction | damage_or_loss

body.raw:
{
  "customer_id": "{{customer_id}}",
  "damage_claim_id": "{{claim_id}}",
  "refund_type": "damage_or_loss",
  "amount_requested_ngn": 132000.00,
  "customer_choice": "immediate_refund",
  "notes": "Refund for water-damaged electronics per resolved claim"
}

item.name: Approve Refund — Head of Finance (CBM/large damage)

request.description: PATCH /v1/refunds/{id}/reject — reject a pending_review or pending_approval refund (tenant_admin or nigeria_office_staff)
GET /v1/packing-lists/{id}/export — generate presigned S3 download URL for packing list XLSX
GET /v1/manifests/{id}/export — generate presigned S3 download URL for manifest XLSX
GET /v1/billing/{id}/export — generate presigned S3 download URL for billing record XLSX
GET /v1/containers/{id}/billing/export — export all billing records for a container as XLSX
POST /v1/packing-lists/import — import packing list items from a pre-uploaded S3 XLSX file (china_office_staff)
GET /v1/webhooks/whatsapp — Meta webhook verification challenge. Returns hub.challenge on success (200 text/plain).
POST /v1/webhooks/whatsapp — Incoming Meta delivery status webhook. Logs status; always returns 200.
